title: Every UI element is a component - declared fields hand-roll bare inputs, and the docs say that is fine
description:
THE LAW, from Fabio 2026-08-20: every single UI element in the app is a COMPONENT. If nothing exists that covers the use, a NEW COMPONENT IS CREATED - that is the answer, not a bare input. FLOWS ARE NO EXCEPTION. A Flow is more flexible in that it can carry all sorts of different components, but they are all components. This is why agents keep turning up in Flows with weird controls that have nothing to do with the rest of the app.

THE DOCUMENTATION CURRENTLY SAYS THE OPPOSITE, AND THAT IS THE ROOT CAUSE. Commit 55461326 (2026-08-14) is titled "feat(flows): declared controls, so a Flow needs no JS component". That framing - declared fields REPLACE components - is what let bare inputs in, and it is repeated across the add-flow playbook, the FlowStepField typedef in js/data/flowsRegistry.js, and the header of js/utils/declaredFields.js. Fixing the code without fixing the words leaves the next agent doing it again.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY BROKEN. js/utils/declaredFields.js buildField() mounts a Primitive for exactly two of its seven field types - MpiRadioGroup for `radio`, MpiButton for `button`. The other five hand-roll raw DOM:
  slider -> ce('input', { type: 'range' })   MpiProgressBar exists and its own docstring says "Absorbs all MpiSlider capabilities - this is the single source of truth for sliders"
  select -> raw <select>                     MpiDropdown exists
  toggle -> raw <input type=checkbox>        MpiCheckbox exists
  text   -> raw <input> / <textarea>         MpiInput exists
  number -> raw <input type=number>          MpiInput exists

HOW IT LOOKS TO A USER, which is how it was caught. The upscale panel's Denoise and Prompt strength sliders render as Chromium's NATIVE range widget with an `accent-color: var(--accent-frost)` tint - wrong geometry, wrong thumb, wrong colour next to every other slider in the app. Fabio spotted it on sight in the History workspace. The app's real slider is appearance:none + a 4px var(--line) rail + a 14px round var(--ink-1) thumb, written LONGHAND in three separate places (MpiToolOptionsMaskAdjust.css:37-57, MpiMaskStrip.css, MpiProgressBar.css). Four independent implementations of one control.

BLAST RADIUS IS BOTH CONSUMERS, NOT JUST THE UPSCALE PANEL. MpiBaseFlow.css:501 and MpiToolOptionsUpscale.css:119 carry the identical `accent-color` line, so EVERY FLOW'S declared sliders look exactly this wrong today. MPI-580 (0a18c242, 2026-08-20) extracted the block from MpiBaseFlow into the shared util verbatim - the extraction was the moment to catch it and instead it doubled the surfaces.

THE FIX IS ONE FILE FOR THE CODE, PLUS A DOC SWEEP:
  1. buildField mounts the existing Primitives - MpiProgressBar (interactive + handle + wheel, the Gallery/volume/PromptBox idiom), MpiDropdown, MpiCheckbox, MpiInput. Both consumers inherit it in one edit; the two accent-color CSS blocks get DELETED, not rewritten.
  2. Sweep the three longhand range implementations onto MpiProgressBar so there is one slider in the app.
  3. REVISE THE FLOWS. Fabio: "flows will need to be revised" - audit every Flow's declared fields and uiComponent for controls that are not app components.
  4. Fix the words: docs/playbooks/add-flow/ (01-descriptor-and-ops.md, the ui/ pages), the FlowStepField typedef, declaredFields.js's header, and state the law explicitly in .claude/rules/components.md so it is in the Critical Rules the router hands every agent. Do NOT edit the rule files without Fabio's go (CLAUDE.md cardinal rule 5).

OWNERSHIP NOTE FOR WHOEVER RUNS THIS: js/utils/declaredFields.js and js/components/Organisms/MpiBaseFlow/* were claimed by a live MPI-504 session on 2026-08-20 - check state/index.json before editing.

SURFACED BY MPI-579 (LTX Video upscaler). That card's own scope passed - Fabio confirmed the upscale ran in the History workspace - and this defect is the surface it shipped onto, not its own work. Carded separately at Fabio's instruction: "Let's create a card, and I'll address it in a separate session for this."

PARTLY DONE ALREADY - Fabio asked for the SLIDERS and the PROMPT BOX to be fixed in the session that raised this card (2026-08-20), so item 1 is half shipped. js/utils/declaredFields.js `buildField` now mounts:
  slider -> MpiProgressBar (interactive + wheel + handle, info '<label>: {value}'), the host keeping the block's `field-range` class so each consumer's existing flex sizing still applies
  text   -> MpiInput (type textarea when rows > 1, `rows` set on the textarea after mount the way MpiPromptBox does it)
NO CSS FILE WAS TOUCHED and none needed to be: `.mpi-progress__input` is appearance:none + transparent, so the leftover `accent-color` declarations are inert. That also kept the edit clear of MpiBaseFlow.css, which a peer session had claimed. Both consumers inherit the fix, so the Flow sliders are correct too.
Verified live in an isolated instance: 2 MpiProgressBar mounts with handle + fill, ZERO raw range inputs, 1 MpiInput textarea at rows=3, fill colour var(--accent-heat) (the app pink, not the frost tint), drag -> readout 0.83 / fill 83% / handle 83%, step 0.01 over 0-1. 630/630 tests, ESLint clean.

STILL OPEN FOR THIS CARD:
  - `select` -> MpiDropdown, `toggle` -> MpiCheckbox, `number` -> MpiInput (type number, which already owns parsing/clamping/decimals - `fieldNumber` may become redundant for that branch)
  - the three longhand `input[type=range]` implementations (MpiToolOptionsMaskAdjust.css, MpiMaskStrip.css, and the raw ranges in their JS) onto MpiProgressBar, so the app has ONE slider
  - the dead `field-range` / `field-text` CSS left behind in MpiBaseFlow.css and MpiToolOptionsUpscale.css
  - REVISE THE FLOWS (the audit Fabio called for)
  - fix the words: add-flow playbook, FlowStepField typedef, declaredFields.js header, and the law in .claude/rules/components.md
